title: An EmDash template kit's blocks take their fields from the theme's stamps, every repeater is a list of its rows, and sections are found again on the captured page
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: rootField names the stored field for items[0].title, items.title and block:items; one cell stamp places every row of a repeater in its block; a block lists every field its stamps place shown or not, and each repeater as a list of its rows; a stamped slot stays with its block when another block shows the same words; a Joomla-shaped block keeps its own lists; a section read on the stamped page is found again on the unstamped page; an older sections file is named stale without a browser and read again with one.

tests: a stamp names its stored field whatever the row or block part it carries
a stamp on one cell of a repeater places every row of that field in the block that prints it
a block lists every field its stamps place, shown at the read width or not, and each repeater as a list
a stamped slot stays with its block when only another block shows its words; without a stamp the shown one wins
a block of a platform that places no slot by stamp keeps its lists from its own groups only
a section read on the stamped page is found again on the page the kit captures, without the page owner
